items.text: Do US forces face an uphill battle?
Why did the twin towers fall?
Is the terrorist attack only part of the answer?
Isn't Sophia off duty today?
When was the chopper(helicopter) hit by enemy fire?
Who dragged off and killed the man(him)?
The current available vaccine is effective, isn't it?
It could(can) be improved, couldn't(can't) it?
The vaccine was administered mostly to military personnel, wasn't it?
Can the program root out terrorists?
Don't officials have evidence?
The terrorists are trying to regroup.
The latest assault is turning out to be tough.
The Operation would last 24 to 72 hours.
It could take up to ten days to complete.
Don't you have to go after them?.
Isn't the only proper defense an offense?
Where were five international peace keepers killed?
Weren't the other two German(s)?
Are fighters hiding in eastern Afghanistan?
Aren't you seeing a clearer picture?
More than forty more were wounded, weren't they?
Are journalists covering the war in Afghanistan?.
Didn't they receive a credible threat?
Non-Afghan journalists could be kidnapped, couldn't they?
Why did journalists immediately assess their security arrangements?
They were taking extra precautions, weren't they?
Isn't the threat their way of retaliating(retaliation)?
When did the remains of seven servicemen return home?
Didn't they arrive at the air force base?
The servicemen(soldiers) died in two separate incidents, didn't they?
Most were not killed in a fierce firefight with Taliban forces, were they?
How did the navy petty officer fall out of his helicopter?
Wasn't he then dragged away by Al Qaeda fighters?
Is the recovery effort destroying vital clues?
Isn't it looking for answers?
Why did the twin towers collapse?
